data.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
data.description: Kneel on the floor holding the wheel under your shoulders. Roll forward as far as you can without letting your hips sag, then pull the wheel back toward your knees. Start with a short range.

data.name: Arnold Press
data.description: Sit with the dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you. Press them overhead while turning your palms to face forward, then reverse the movement on the way down.

data.name: Assisted Pull-up
data.description: Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles wider than your shoulders. Pull yourself up until your chin is over the handles, then lower yourself slowly. The selected weight helps you, so reduce it as you get stronger.

data.name: Back Extension
data.description: Set the pad just below your hips and cross your arms over your chest. Bend forward at the hips with a flat back, then raise your torso until your body is in a straight line. Do not arch past that line.

data.name: Band Chest Press
data.description: Anchor the band behind you at chest height, or loop it around your back, and hold an end in each hand. Press your hands forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly. Step further from the anchor to make it harder.

data.name: Band Curl
data.description: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the ends with your palms facing forward. Curl your hands toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows at your sides, then lower them slowly.

data.name: Band Deadlift
data.description: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart and hold the ends beside your shins. With a flat back, stand up by driving your hips forward, then lower your hands slowly.

data.name: Band Face Pull
data.description: Anchor the band at face height and hold an end in each hand with your arms straight. Pull your hands toward your ears, keeping your elbows high, then return slowly.

data.name: Band Lat Pulldown
data.description: Anchor the band above your head, for example over a door, and kneel facing it. Pull the ends down to your shoulders, driving your elbows toward your hips, then let your arms rise slowly.

data.name: Band Lateral Raise
data.description: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the ends at your sides. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height with your elbows slightly bent, then lower them slowly.

data.name: Band Lateral Walk
data.description: Place a loop band around your legs just above your knees and lower into a quarter squat. Take small steps to the side while keeping the band tight, then walk back the other way. Count each step as one repetition.

data.name: Band Overhead Press
data.description: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the ends at your shoulders, palms facing forward. Press your hands overhead until your arms are straight, then lower them slowly.

data.name: Band Pallof Press
data.description: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it, holding the end against your chest with both hands. Press your hands straight out, resist the pull that tries to turn you, then bring them back. Finish all repetitions before changing sides.

data.name: Band Pull-Apart
data.description: Hold the band in front of your chest with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return slowly.

data.name: Band Seated Row
data.description: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and the band looped around your feet. Pull the ends to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return slowly. Keep your torso upright.

data.name: Band Squat
data.description: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders. Squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand back up against the pull of the band.

data.name: Band Triceps Pushdown
data.description: Anchor the band above your head and hold an end in each hand with your elbows at your sides. Push your hands down until your arms are straight, then let them rise slowly. Only your forearms move.

data.name: Barbell Back Squat
data.description: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Sit back and down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up and your knees in line with your toes, then stand back up.

data.name: Barbell Bench Press
data.description: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and grip it slightly wider than shoulder width. Lower the bar to mid-chest with your elbows at about 45 degrees, then press it back up until your arms are straight. Keep your feet on the floor and your shoulder blades pulled together.

data.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
data.description: Hold the bar with an overhand grip and hinge forward until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, knees slightly bent. Pull the bar to your lower ribs, then lower it until your arms are straight. Keep your back flat throughout.

data.name: Barbell Curl
data.description: Stand holding the bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width. Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your elbows forward, then lower it slowly. Keep your torso still.

data.name: Barbell Deadlift
data.description: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot, feet hip-width apart, and grip it just outside your legs. With a flat back and braced core, push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your body. Lower it the same way, hinging at the hips first.

data.name: Barbell Front Squat
data.description: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high. Squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your torso upright, then stand back up. Do not let your elbows drop.

data.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
data.description: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the bar across your hips, feet flat on the floor. Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, squeeze your glutes, then lower your hips. Use a pad under the bar.

data.name: Bear Crawl
data.description: Start on your hands and feet with your knees bent just above the floor. Crawl forward by moving the opposite hand and foot together, keeping your back flat and your hips low.

data.name: Endurance Ride
data.description: Steady aerobic ride at a controlled heart-rate zone.

data.name: Farmer's Walk
data.description: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall. Walk with short, steady steps for the set time, keeping your shoulders back and your core braced. Put the weights down before your grip fails.
